review_routing.additional_review: sonnet_report_grounded_and_reconciled; raw reviewer claims never silently change this contract

boundary.current_executable_scope: story_ledger and story_seal only; non-null production_state/final_seal are rejected until strict schemas land

identity.run_id: one production execution of a sealed story; absent at Story Lab output
identity.workspace_id: renameable production directory/slug identity; never story identity
identity.resume: retains run_id and appends a phase attempt
identity.rerender: new run_id, same episode_id and story_sha256
identity.story_revision: new sealed story artifact and new episode_id
identity.schema_migration: explicit registered edge and migration receipt only

minimum_ship_evidence.ledger_integrity: body_sha256 is the structural evidence; evidence_refs may be empty
minimum_ship_evidence.news_capture: typed refs must name the exact source packet and at least one accepted fact
minimum_ship_evidence.announcer_open: a typed line ref must name the exact announcer_open line
minimum_ship_evidence.announcer_news_coda: typed refs must name the exact coda line and at least one fact cited by that line
minimum_ship_evidence.music_bookends: typed music_cue refs must name the exact music_open and music_close cues

policies.ledger_integrity: fresh strict StoryBody validation with identical canonical bytes plus otr.spoken-text-only.v1
policies.news_capture: exact external captured-packet raw-byte SHA-256 plus strict full projection equality and receipt-named packet/facts
policies.announcer_open: first spoken announcer line contains normalized literal premise, setting, scene time, and every character name
policies.announcer_news_coda: last spoken announcer line contains the normalized complete claim of at least one receipt-named fact cited by that line
policies.music_bookends: receipt names the exact compiler-owned cues at sequence index zero and the terminal index

spoken_text_policy.scope: every speech row rejects production cues and delimited stage directions; character rows additionally reject quoted novel dialogue, third-person stage business, and cross-speaker attribution
spoken_text_policy.calibration: the clean normative v1 fixture passes and the exact 2026-08-13 Light of Possibility challenger fails
spoken_text_policy.repair: forbidden during trusted admission; reject and return to the writer

executable_fixture_corpus.dependent_digest_policy: recompute body and story digests before later-gate admission checks

source_packet_digest.hash_target: captured upstream source-packet artifact before accepted-story projection

story_invariants.rule: Every schema version is exact and unknown versions fail.
IDs are nonempty and unique within every table.
All source, fact, cast, scene, shot, beat, line, cue, and sequence references resolve with no orphans.
Every spoken line carries speaker, speaker_role, and char_id matching the immutable cast row.

Every speech row contains only words intended for its assigned voice; production cues, stage directions, quoted novel prose, third-person stage business, and cross-speaker attribution fail trusted ledger-integrity admission.
Every line carries fact_ids; each resolves to a source-backed fact.
Every spoken line and music cue appears exactly once in the ordered sequence, and each table order matches its sequence projection.
Scene child-shot, shot child-beat, and beat child-line projections exactly match the corresponding table order.
Exactly one music_open is sequence index zero.
Exactly one announcer_open is the first spoken row and routes as announcer.
One or more character_dialogue rows route as character.
music_inter is optional, script-requested, and located inside the character-story body.
music_open and music_close cues are compiler-owned bookends; only music_inter uses script request authority.
Exactly one announcer_news_coda is the last spoken row and routes as announcer.
The announcer_news_coda references at least one valid source fact.
Exactly one music_close is the final sequence row.
All five outcome receipts pass, bind the same body_sha256, and carry the outcome-specific evidence declared by minimum_ship_evidence.

story_seal.canonicalization: UTF-8, NFC strings, no floats, sorted object keys, compact separators, no NaN/Infinity
story_seal.enforcement: fresh structural revalidation plus code-owned trusted receipt verifiers before sealing; verify before and after every future production phase and durable save

final_seal.hash_target: story digest plus complete accepted production_state after publish and audit
final_seal.precondition: every required run-plan phase has one accepted succeeded attempt
final_seal.postcondition: no ordinary ledger mutation is legal

production_phase_registry.purpose: run_id, workspace_id, episode-local paths and rename/rebase receipts
voice identity and routing receipts keyed by immutable char_id
line-audio artifacts, hashes, cache and engine receipts keyed by immutable line_id
rendered cue artifacts and hashes keyed by immutable cue_id
positioned speech/cue timing and sequencing receipts
master audio, transitions, and master-audio identity
base procedural video artifact; any rename request is resolved by the workspace_identity owner
derived shot/render work bound to immutable beat and line IDs
portrait/still artifacts and provenance bound to cast/shot/beat IDs
clip artifacts, routes, coverage and engine receipts
clip-manifest composite artifact; no episode-ledger input
scene-aware scopes artifact derived from the clip manifest
final silent video blend/upscale artifact and processing receipt
caption artifact receipt; read-only story consumer
credits artifact receipt; read-only story/production consumer
terminal audit receipt before final seal

current_l4_compatibility.reason: current l4 has legitimate post-freeze in-place writes, mixed routing/sequence roles, and can discard SciFi fact_ids
current_l4_compatibility.required_path: new explicit adapter preserving story bytes, fact_ids, speaker authority, sequence roles and seal; then production receipts move to production_state
current_l4_compatibility.legacy_control: historical semantic evidence only; c01 versus announcer identity requires explicit migration before v1 admission
current_l4_compatibility.id_namespace: typed per table; identical literals in different tables are allowed and references resolve by kind
